section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section discusses the shift in body image research from pathology-driven approaches to positive body image, defining positive body image as love and acceptance of one's body. The authors note that body appreciation is the most widely-researched facet of positive body image and that men tend to have higher levels of body appreciation than women. The section indicates that the present study will investigate correlates of body appreciation in men, explore differences across sexual orientation, and explain these differences—marking this as the first study to investigate these aspects.
section_summary.evidence_source: Entire introduction section, particularly the final paragraph stating 'The present study will contribute to filling this gap by (a) investigating the correlates of body appreciation in men, (b) exploring whether levels of body appreciation differ across sexual orientation, and (c) if so, what explains these differences.'
